calls.reason: The UK white paper records business worries about regulatory divergence, and the BLOOM study shows that training has an emissions cost. Neither shows that common standards avoid country-specific training or cut emissions.

The EU's general-purpose AI rules took effect in 2025, and Google said it would sign the Code of Practice while voicing concerns. One company's promise to sign does not show substantive compliance across major firms.

Expert surveys (HIIG, GovAI) support the claim among informed stakeholders. The May 2023 YouGov poll shows a divided public, but it never asks about risks, opportunities and urgency together, so near-universal recognition is neither shown nor clearly refuted.
